outputs.name: kv_cache_k
outputs.desc: K cache slice at current pos. Physical capacity S_max rows; valid-token count is tracked separately by the caller (append index); append writes exactly the rows at the append index and never reads beyond valid rows.

outputs.name: kv_cache_v
outputs.desc: V cache slice at current pos. Physical capacity S_max rows; valid-token count is tracked separately by the caller (append index); append writes exactly the rows at the append index and never reads beyond valid rows.

constraints.notes: Scheduling may round the extent to physical capacity S_max; kernels must never read or write KV rows beyond the valid-token count declared by the append index.

impl.c_declaration: void kv_cache_store(float *kv_cache_k, float *kv_cache_v, const float *k, const float *v, int layer, int pos, int num_kv_heads, int head_dim, int max_seq_len);
impl.inline_code: /* KV cache store is inlined as memcpy in codegen */

notes: Store K and V to KV cache at current position. Typically inlined as memcpy in generated code.
